cohort: 1,028 women who gave birth between January 1st and November 30th, 2018, at a tertiary obstetrics department in Southern Italy
finding: The only thrombotic events observed in the cohort were isolated pulmonary embolisms, found in 2 out of 12 women who received blood transfusions.
mod_finding: 7 out of the 12 women who received blood transfusions had given birth via Caesarean section
